summary: Sync Reserving Class with ResQ now carries Notes in both directions for every dataset and method.
details: An ArcRho-to-ResQ row writes the notes kept on the dataset's or method's Notes tab into the ResQ Notes field with their line breaks intact; an empty note clears the ResQ notes. Before this, notes were never written, so a synced DFM showed stale or empty notes in ResQ.
A ResQ-to-ArcRho row brings ResQ's notes into ArcRho for triangles and vectors as well as methods; dataset notes used to come across blank.
Every write is checked by reading the notes back, like the other fields the sync applies.
Export Reserving Class to ResQ (1.3.0), whose writer the sync uses, pushes notes the same way.
